"""Unit tests for mdata.io.read_csv (DATA-01)."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from mdata.io import read_csv
from mdata.types import RawRow


def _write(tmp_path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
    path.write_text(text)
    return path


def test_reads_every_row_in_file_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(
        tmp_path,
        "date,ticker,close\n2024-03-05,BOLT,20.0\n2024-03-04,ACME,50.5\n2024-03-04,BOLT,19\n",
    )
    assert read_csv(path) == [
        RawRow("2024-03-05", "BOLT", 20.0),
        RawRow("2024-03-04", "ACME", 50.5),
        RawRow("2024-03-04", "BOLT", 19.0),
    ]


def test_blank_close_is_none_not_zero(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n2024-03-05,BOLT,\n2024-03-06,BOLT, \n")

from pathlib import Path

from mdata.pipeline import load_prices
from mdata.types import Prices

CSV = (
    "date,ticker,close\n"
    "2024-03-04,BOLT,20.0\n"
    "2024-03-04,ACME,50.0\n"
    "2024-03-05,ACME,51.0\n"
    "2024-03-05,BOLT,20.2\n"
    "2024-03-06,ACME,49.5\n"
    "2024-03-06,BOLT,20.5\n"
)


def test_load_prices_runs_end_to_end(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
    path.write_text(CSV)
    prices = load_prices(path)
    assert isinstance(prices, Prices)
    assert prices.tickers == ("ACME", "BOLT")
    assert len(prices.dates) > 0
    assert set(prices.closes) == {"ACME", "BOLT"}
    for ticker in prices.tickers:
        assert len(prices.closes[ticker]) == len(prices.dates)


def test_load_prices_keeps_only_requested_tickers(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
    path.write_text(CSV)
    prices = load_prices(str(path), ["BOLT"])
    assert prices.tickers == ("BOLT",)
    assert len(prices.closes["BOLT"]) == len(prices.dates)

    assert set(prices.closes) == {"ACME", "BOLT"}
    for ticker in prices.tickers:
        assert len(prices.closes[ticker]) == len(prices.dates)


def test_load_prices_keeps_only_requested_tickers(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
    path.write_text(CSV)
    prices = load_prices(str(path), ["BOLT"])
    assert prices.tickers == ("BOLT",)
    assert len(prices.closes["BOLT"]) == len(prices.dates)
